premises.text: Space assets currently carry only one tank of fuel, so empty satellites must be destroyed
premises.evidence_span: It is time to stop throwing satellites away

premises.text: Gas stations in space: tanks launched opportunistically, orbital logistics, and delivery of the right propellant on demand
premises.evidence_span: We're building gas stations in space

premises.text: A standardized drop-in fueling port with self-aligning connection enables safe, reliable on-orbit refueling without costly robotic attendants
premises.evidence_span: This fueling port allows satellites to be refueled safely and reliably in orbit

premises.text: Customers save about 50% CapEx and the operator targets very high gross margins
premises.evidence_span: Our customers can save 50 percent on their capital expenditure, and we take home gross margins of 90 percent

value.text: Keep satellites operating and earning by refueling them in orbit
value.evidence_span: make more money for its owners

secondary_value.text: Recover lost satellite revenue previously destroyed with empty craft
secondary_value.evidence_span: recover billions of dollars of lost revenue

causal_links.evidence_span: No system exists for safely and reliably fueling a satellite in space. So we set out to solve that problem first
save 50 percent on their capital expenditure
